title: Coast Guard rescues 2 after vessel sinks 34 miles off Charleston
description: A Coast Guard Air Station Savannah MH-65 Dolphin helicopter crew hoists two people from a life raft after their 30-foot fishing vessel sank 34 miles off Charleston, South Carolina, Dec. 20, 2023. The helicopter crew safely transported the two men to the Medical University of South Carolina in Charleston for further medical care. (U.S. Coast Guard video, courtesy Air Station Savannah)
